verdicts.claim: In mpv 0.40.0 the --target-colorspace-hint=auto probe (ra_swapchain_fns.target_csp) is implemented only by the d3d11 swapchain; vo_gpu_next assumes PQ when the probe is missing, so on winvk 'auto' behaves like 'yes'. --target-peak / display MaxLuminance replaces the hint's max_luma.
verdicts.evidence: video/out/vo_gpu_next.c v0.40.0 lines 979-984: "// Assume HDR is supported, if query is not available\n// TODO: Implement this for all backends\ntarget_csp = sw->fns->target_csp ? sw->fns->target_csp(sw) : (struct pl_color_space){ .transfer = PL_COLOR_TRC_PQ };" and lines 990-1004: "float target_peak = opts->target_peak ? opts->target_peak : target_csp.hdr.max_luma; ... bool target_hint = p->next_opts->target_hint == 1 || (p->next_opts->target_hint == -1 && pl_color_transfer_is_hdr(target_csp.transfer)); ... if (target_peak) hint.hdr.max_luma = target_peak;". grep -n target_csp over v0.40.0 d3d11/context.c, vulkan/context.c, vulkan/context_win.c, gpu/context.c returns only "video/out/d3d11/context.c:495:    .target_csp   = d3d11_target_color_space,". d3d11_target_color_space (context.c 192-235) maps DXGI_COLOR_SPACE_RGB_FULL_G22_NONE_P709 -> PL_COLOR_TRC_SRGB (not HDR -> no hint) and RGB_FULL_G2084_NONE_P2020 -> PL_COLOR_TRC_PQ, and reads desc1.MaxLuminance/MinLuminance/primaries.

verdicts.claim: With --wid=<HWND>, mpv creates its own WS_CHILD|WS_VISIBLE window (CreateWindowExW, WS_EX_NOPARENTNOTIFY) sized to the parent's client rect, installs a hook to follow parent resizes, and its own fullscreen/window-state handling returns early when parented, so the host must go borderless/fullscreen itself.
verdicts.evidence: video/out/w32_common.c v0.40.0 lines 2038-2047: "if (w32->opts->WinID >= 0) w32->parent = (HWND)(intptr_t)(w32->opts->WinID); ... GetClientRect(w32->parent, &r); CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_NOPARENTNOTIFY, (LPWSTR)MAKEINTATOM(cls), MPV_WINDOW_CLASS_NAME, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE, 0, 0, r.right, r.bottom, w32->parent, 0, HINST_THISCOMPONENT, w32);". update_fullscreen_state (line ~1058): "if (w32->parent) return;"; same early return in update_window_state (1171), reinit_window_state (1261), update_maximized_state (1113). install_parent_hook (1872-1886): "// If the parent lives inside the current process, install a Windows hook" (WH_CALLWNDPROC) "else { // Otherwise, use a WinEvent hook. These don't seem to be as smooth as Windows hooks, but they can be delivered across process boundaries. ... SetWinEventHook(EVENT_OBJECT_LOCATIONCHANGE, ...)"; resize_child_win resizes with SetWindowPos(..., SWP_ASYNCWINDOWPOS ...). Note: with mpv.exe launched by the WinForms host the cross-process WinEvent path is the one used.

verdicts.claim: HDR passthrough works when mpv is embedded in a WinForms child window via --wid (d3d11 + colorspace hint); only mpv.net user reports support it.
verdicts.evidence: Supporting primary evidence, but no direct test of a child HWND found: (1) libplacebo v7.349.0 src/d3d11/swapchain.c line 486 creates the swapchain with IDXGIFactory2_CreateSwapChainForHwnd on whatever HWND mpv gives (the child window), and set_swapchain_metadata (lines 282-310) calls IDXGISwapChain3_SetColorSpace1 then IDXGISwapChain4_SetHDRMetaData per swapchain. (2) Microsoft 'Use DirectX with Advanced Color' doc: "When in HDR mode, the Desktop Window Manager (DWM) uses a canonical composition color space ... The DWM converts each app from its native color space to CCCS before blending" and Option 2 ("DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM ... explicitly call IDXGISwapChain3::SetColorSpace1 ... DXGI_COLOR_SPACE_RGB_FULL_G2084_NONE_P2020") is documented for swap chains created via CreateSwapChainFor[Hwnd|Composition|CoreWindow] with no fullscreen requirement; it also states DXGI reports Advanced-Color SDR displays as G22_P709 and "DXGI doesn't let you check what Advanced Color kinds are supported-but-not-active". (3) mpv issue #10628 (open, 2022-09-10): in windowed mode the picture displays but "no metadata is passed through. The hdfury shows the default windows HDR values"; reporter notes this hits "any software that embeds mpv". (4) mpv issue #17570 (mpv.net host, RTX 4070, v0.41.0-60): "target-colorspace-hint=yes | Correct HDR brightness but screen flickers when resizing or toggling fullscreen". (5) mpv.net issue #601 'HDR Passthrough Not Working' (open 2023-12) is an unanswered config question, no evidence either way. Conclusion: mechanism is per-HWND swapchain + DWM HDR composition, so a child window should behave like any windowed mpv (correct picture, no static metadata forwarded); still needs the 5-minute stats-page test on the friend's PC.

verdicts.claim: (mpv.conf snippet note) 'The [hint-source] profile uses an option that does not exist in 0.40.0 (mpv will error on unknown options in a profile only when the profile is applied).'
verdicts.evidence: Local experiment, mpv 0.40.0, the report's mpv.conf written to a --config-dir and run WITHOUT --profile: stderr prints "Error parsing option target-colorspace-hint-mode (option not found)" and "/.../cfg/mpv.conf:39: setting option target-colorspace-hint-mode='source' failed." (line 39 is inside the [hint-source] section). Identical output with --profile=sdr-quality. The error is non-fatal (exit 0, playback continues) but is emitted at config-load time, not when the profile is applied.
verdicts.correction: mpv validates every option in every profile section when it parses mpv.conf. For a conf shared with a 0.40.0 build, remove the [hint-source] section (or ship two conf files); instead let the receiver GUI run `mpv --version`, and only for 0.41+/nightly builds append --target-colorspace-hint-mode=source (or a profile defined in a separate file passed with --include) on the command line. The stray error is harmless to playback but will appear in logs.

experiments_run.command: curl api.github.com issues 10628 (+comments), 17570, mpvnet-player/mpv.net issue 601 (+comments), search mpv.net issues 'HDR'
experiments_run.result: #10628 open since 2022-09-10: fullscreen passes HDR10 metadata, windowed mode does not (hdfury shows Windows defaults; AMD 1499/799); 2026-03 comments: ACM/Win11 24H2 remarks, Vulkan adds ~1 s startup and broke AV1 hwdec for one user. #17570 (mpv.net host, RTX 4070): hint=yes -> correct HDR brightness but black flash on resize/fullscreen; hint=no -> dim. mpv.net #601: unanswered config question, no technical content.

Confirms DWM composites all windows in FP16 scRGB when HDR mode is on; Option 2 (R10G10B10A2 + SetColorSpace1 G2084_P2020) documented for CreateSwapChainForHwnd swapchains without a fullscreen requirement; DXGI_OUTPUT_DESC1.ColorSpace = G2084_P2020 only when HDR is active; Advanced-Color SDR displays are reported as G22_P709; doc does not state any metadata/fullscreen limitation explicitly.

extra_findings: [verified] 0.41.0 semantics change for --target-colorspace-hint=auto: the hint is applied whenever the display transfer is KNOWN (vo_gpu_next.c 0.41 lines 1113-1116: `target_csp.transfer != PL_COLOR_TRC_UNKNOWN`), i.e. on an SDR monitor with Windows HDR off, 0.41 sets an sRGB/G22 swapchain hint (mpv still tone-maps in-shader; the manual calls this 'crucial for all non-sRGB content, even SDR'). In 0.40 'auto' only hints when the display reports PQ. Both versions are fine for the receiver; just expect different stats-page 'target' lines.

[verified] 0.41.0 adds --target-colorspace-hint-strict (default yes: 'the configured swapchain colorspace (with the hint) will be respected ... --target-* options act only as a hint') and, in 0.41 vo_gpu_next.c, the reported display peak is discarded in SDR mode ('Don't use reported display peak in SDR mode ... target_csp.hdr.max_luma = 0'). So the report's --target-peak override advice applies to HDR mode only.

[verified] 0.41.0 changed the hwdec autoprobe order (vd_lavc.c): d3d11va, vulkan, dxva2, nvdec, vaapi, vdpau, drm, mediacodec, videotoolbox, then every -copy variant; RELEASE_NOTES: 'Vulkan hardware decoding is preferred over other APIs' and 'gpu-next is now the default'. Passing --hwdec=d3d11va explicitly (as the snippets do) sidesteps this.

[verified] 0.41.0 adds --d3d11-output-mode=<auto|window|composition> (composition = no window, for WinUI/SwapChainPanel hosts; swapchain address exposed via the `display-swapchain` property), --hdr-reference-white, --sdr-adjust-gamma, --treat-srgb-as-power22, --hwdec-threads. No 0.40 options were removed in 0.41 (header diff shows no deletions), so --d3d11-output-csp/-format still exist.

[verified] Cross-process embedding detail (w32_common.c): when mpv.exe is launched by a separate WinForms process with --wid, mpv follows parent resizes through SetWinEventHook(EVENT_OBJECT_LOCATIONCHANGE, WINEVENT_OUTOFCONTEXT) — the code comments 'These don't seem to be as smooth as Windows hooks' — and resizes the child with SWP_ASYNCWINDOWPOS only when the parent's client rect changes. In-process libmpv hosting gets the WH_CALLWNDPROC hook instead. Combined with #17570's black flash on resize, keep the video panel size static (fixed panel or borderless-fullscreen form) or drive resizes from the host deliberately.

[verified] For the input-rate stat use the top-level property `cache-speed` (MPV_FORMAT_INT64 bytes/s; input.rst: 'This is the same as demuxer-cache-state/raw-input-rate'); `raw-input-rate` is only added to the demuxer-cache-state node when bytes_per_second > 0 (command.c 1557), and sub-paths of that node are not addressable. `video-params/max-luma` returns 'property unavailable' for SDR content and `video-target-params` is unavailable until a real VO exists — the C# reader must tolerate missing `data`.

[verified] mpv 0.40 does NOT tolerate unknown options inside unused profile sections: they log 'Error parsing option ... (option not found)' at config load (non-fatal). A single mpv.conf cannot carry 0.41-only options for a 0.40 build without log noise; version-gate them on the command line instead.

[verified] Microsoft's Advanced Color doc states Win32 apps should NOT use IDXGISwapChain::GetContainingOutput to refresh DXGI_OUTPUT_DESC1 after display changes because it returns a stale output; 0.41 moved the probe to an HWND-based helper (mp_dxgi_output_desc_from_hwnd) while 0.40's d3d11_target_color_space queries via the swapchain (mp_get_dxgi_output_desc(p->swapchain, ...)). [uncertain] whether 0.40 therefore fails to notice Windows HDR being toggled while mpv runs — practical mitigation: restart mpv.exe after toggling Win+Alt+B.

[verified] Microsoft doc: DXGI_OUTPUT_DESC1.ColorSpace is G2084_P2020 only while Windows HDR mode is active, and 'DXGI doesn't let you check what Advanced Color kinds are supported-but-not-active' — consistent with the report's rule that the user must enable Windows HDR before launching mpv; the receiver GUI cannot detect an HDR-capable-but-disabled display via mpv.

[verified] Sanity check on the read-ahead arithmetic: with a source faster than real time and no --cache-secs cap, 0.40's demuxer buffered 1159 s of lavfi video in 2.5 s (bounded only by demuxer-max-bytes), so the cap (--cache-secs=8 -> exactly 8.0 s) is what keeps the live buffer bounded when the relay bursts after a stall; --demuxer-max-bytes must be >= cache-secs x bitrate (8 s x 12.5 MB/s = 100 MB at 100 Mbps) or the byte cap wins first.

[likely] Vulkan on Windows: #10628 2026-03 comment reports winvk adds ~1 s startup and broke AV1 hwdec on an RTX 3080; a 2022 comment reports AMD Vulkan HDR not working at all and NVIDIA Vulkan sending no HDR metadata even in fullscreen. Reinforces the d3d11 recommendation.
